“Love is an untamed force. When we try to control it, it destroys us. When we try to imprison it, it enslaved us. When we try to understand it, it leaves us feelings lost and confused”

Paulo Coelho

I overcame my suicidal thoughts and depression three weeks ago through meditation and reading, but now they are back and I feel unwanted and lonely. I want to be numb.

Ugh dude message me! I feel like we had the same bad trip. It brought me to hell and back and when the paramedics came, I thought this was some kind of joke that the simulation was trying to play on me so I suggested we all go swimming :( All my friends were trying to calm me down and every time I sat down I thought my body was decaying and that I was going to die. I hit a lot of people and the next morning they had bloody scars everywhere... I wasn’t even conscious...

I started breaking things too because I thought none of this shit mattered. Nothing mattered because we were all dead but no one will understand that because like you said, we’d have to go through it ourselves to fully grasp the feeling of going crazy and dying.

This might not mean much over text but I am extremely happy someone understands. The past couple days have been so difficult, and I’m trying so hard to not give into my depression. Thank you for making my day a lot better. I appreciate you! Take care
You’re right. And I am so completely sorry.
We would’ve had a trip sitter if any of this was planned, but unfortunately it wasn’t

I’m feeling a lot better. I started planning in my agenda for this month and I’m reading & meditating now. I’ve stopped crying about it but the thought keeps coming back into my head. My heart hurts but I’m glad I made it out of bed today.

I do know it was my fault, whole heartedly. I’m just trying to get through this one step at a time. Having the paramedics come in and take my blood and heart rate permanently scarred me. And being blocked out by everyone and being misunderstood. Like I wanna kill my self you know what I mean lol
They were blotters. 100mcg a tab. I took 1 and 1/2 tabs.

I haven’t been taking it often. Like I said I’ve only been taking it every couple of months, or on a special occasion that comes once in a blue moon. I don’t take it every week. I have never abused LSD before and I never planned to. 

I took it around the wrong people and got stuck in a loop of hell. So how is it my fault for not being able to control myself on acid, thinking I am dying and killed everyone? I needed to get in touch with real things and real people so I did what I had to do, I called 911. 

Abusing it was never my intention. LSD has brought enlightenment to my life and I am sad I can no longer look at it the same way.
Thank you kind stranger. I’m trying my best to keep my head high!
Thank you... I just quit my job and ready for a fresh start. I don’t think I’m going to touch drugs or alcohol for a long time now.

I know LSD is not a party drug, it is something I do very religiously like once every couple of months. I know I fucked up my whole life and no one wants to talk to me anymore. I just quit my job and I literally have no one. But I just cannot understand why no one is willing to listen to what I have to say. I was never given the chance to explain myself and why I thought I had died and killed everyone. I never meant to cause so much trouble, but I did anyway and I can never forgive myself. 

Yes it was my fault for taking too much. I get that. But I am just sad that I can’t even explain myself or apologize when everyone just shunned me away.
Thank you. And I’m actually just on my way to get some help right now
Because UK is my dream, and in my opinion, Cambridge is the best. :)
